blocks.text:
After breakfast, set out by motorboat on the Preguiças River at 8:30 a.m. It is one of the region’s main waterways. Mangroves and sandy stretches line the banks, alongside small villages where fishing and the river shape daily life.

Your first stop is Vassouras, known as Little Lençóis. You can buy fresh coconut water among the dunes, and capuchin monkeys accustomed to people can be seen near the boardwalks.

Continue by boat to the fishing village and the Preguiças Lighthouse. It takes 160 steps to reach the viewing platform, with views of the dunes, the winding river, the Atlantic and the green coastline. After lunch, transfer back to São Luís.

Today you’ll see the region from the water. After yesterday’s dunes, the focus shifts to the river and its mangrove banks. Small settlements line the Preguiças, boats are part of everyday transport, and fishing remains part of local life. The view from the lighthouse brings the different landscapes of Lençóis Maranhenses together.
